messages.subject: bang head against the wall
parts:
Dear all,

here is a thing that almost makes me bang my head against the wall. I get the following error when trying to run a static occupancy model:

Fehler in occu(~1 ~ 1, data = umf2) :
  Data is not an unmarkedFrameOccu object.

I am simulating data using our simOcc function from the AHM book (get R package from here: http://www.mbr-pwrc.usgs.gov/pubanalysis/keryroylebook/). Then, I fit the simple occupancy model and afterwards, 'degrade' the detection histories to removal design data (by turning all data after first detection into an NA) and try to fit the same model again to a new unmarked data frame with the removal data filled in. And then the thing breaks. I just can't see where my error is and would be grateful for any help.

Here is my code (and you will need that AHMbook package, too).

Thanks for help.

Marc

library(unmarked)

 

simrep <- 10

estimates <- array(NA, dim = c(2, 2, simrep))

dimnames(estimates) <- list(c("psi", "p"), c("traditional", "removal"), NULL)

 

for(k in 1:simrep){

  cat(paste("\n *** Simrep", k, " ***\n\n"))

  # simulate a data set

  data <- simOcc(M = 267, J = 3, mean.occupancy = 0.6,
    beta1 = 0, beta2 = 0, beta3 = 0, mean.detection = 0.3,
    time.effects = c(0, 0), alpha1 = 0, alpha2 = 0, alpha3 = 0,
    sd.lp = 1, b = 0, show.plot = FALSE)

 

 

  # Fit normal occupancy model

  summary(umf1 <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y = data$y))

  summary(fm1 <- occu(~1 ~1, data=umf1))

  estimates[,1,k] <- coef(fm1)

 

 

  # Fit removal occupancy model

  yrm <- data$y        # make a copy, yrm for y removal design

  for(i in 1:data$M){

    for(j in 2:data$J){

      yrm[i,j] <- ifelse(yrm[i,(j-1)] == 1, NA, yrm[i,j])

    }

  }

  summary(umf2 <- unmarkedFrame(y = yrm))

  summary(fm2 <- occu(~1 ~1, data = umf2))

  tmp2 <- summary(fm2)

  estimates[,2,k] <- coef(fm2)

}

}
